_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Ancient Peoples and Early Trade Routes
910.label: Event
910.description: Ancient habitation at the crossroads of Africa and Arabia; early pastoralist cultures; rock art; links to the Land of Punt.

910.name: Prehistoric Rock Art and Pastoralists
910.label: Event
910.description: Neolithic rock art at Abourma and Balho; early Cushitic-speaking pastoralists in the Afar depression.

910.name: Possible Link to Land of Punt
910.label: Event
910.description: Djibouti region as possible part of the ancient Land of Punt; Egyptian trade expeditions for myrrh, frankincense, and gold.

920.name: Islamic Sultanates and Trade
920.label: Event
920.description: Islamisation of the region; Ifat and Adal sultanates; Djibouti as part of broader Horn of Africa Islamic polities; Red Sea trade.

920.name: Islamisation of the Afar and Issa
920.label: Event
920.description: Spread of Islam through Arab traders and scholars; conversion of Afar and Issa peoples; mosque construction.

920.name: Adal Sultanate Influence
920.label: Event
920.description: Djibouti region under influence of Adal Sultanate; Ahmed Gran's jihad against Ethiopia; Zeila as major port.

930.name: Ottoman and Egyptian Influence
930.label: Event
930.description: Ottoman Empire and Egyptian Khedivate contest control of the Red Sea coast; Afar sultanates maintain local autonomy.

930.name: Ottoman Red Sea Expansion
930.label: Event
930.description: Ottoman influence on the Red Sea coast; Afar sultanate of Tadjoura maintains semi-autonomy under Ottoman suzerainty.

930.name: Egyptian Khedivate and Regional Rivalry
930.label: Event
930.description: Egyptian expansion into Horn of Africa; brief control of ports; rivalry with Ethiopia and European powers.

940.name: French Somaliland
940.label: Event
940.description: French acquisition of Obock then Djibouti city; strategic coaling station; Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway; WWII and Cold War developments.

940.name: French Acquisition and Obock
940.label: Event
940.description: France acquires Obock from Afar sultans 1862; establishes Djibouti city 1888 as capital; coal and supply port.

940.name: Addis Ababa–Djibouti Railway
940.label: Event
940.description: Franco-Ethiopian railway constructed 1897-1917; transforms Djibouti into Ethiopia's primary trade outlet.

950.name: Independence and Gouled Presidency
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence 27 June 1977; Hassan Gouled Aptidon's single-party rule; Afar insurgency; limited multiparty opening.

950.name: Independence of Djibouti
950.label: Event
950.description: Djibouti gains independence 27 June 1977; Hassan Gouled Aptidon becomes first president; French military remains.

950.name: Gouled Single-Party Rule
950.label: Event
950.description: RPP single-party state; Issa-dominated governance; marginalisation of Afar community; French security guarantee.

960.name: Guelleh Era and Strategic Hub
960.label: Event
960.description: Ismaïl Omar Guelleh's presidency; Djibouti as global military base hub; post-9/11 strategic importance; economic modernisation.

960.name: Guelleh Consolidation of Power
960.label: Event
960.description: Guelleh succeeds Gouled 1999; constitutional amendment removes term limits 2010; opposition suppressed.

960.name: Foreign Military Bases
960.label: Event
960.description: US Camp Lemonnier (2001); French Forces Djibouti; Chinese PLA base (2017, first overseas); Japanese and other installations; rent income.
